title: Kurulum's claimed Camunda Gold partnership does not appear in Camunda's 204-partner directory
content:
Kurulum claims Camunda Gold Partner status on its own website. The research checked that against Camunda's directory of 204 partners and could not find the firm, recording the claim as unverified.

This is the one entry in the sweep where a claim was actively contradicted rather than merely left unevidenced. The mechanism of the check is worth generalising: partner tiers are marketing assets that a firm controls, whereas the vendor's directory is the authority that issues them, and comparing the two costs a single lookup. Most of the tool and partnership data in this corpus is self-reported, so a cheap corroboration step applies well beyond this row.

The firm is excluded regardless — it is based in Istanbul, outside the EU scope, and the whole row was mined from the Flowable Partner Finder on 2026-08-18 without an imprint sweep. The value of the note is the method, not the lead.

## Leads sharing this finding (1)

**9 · do not pitch**
- Kurulum (TR Istanbul) — kurul.com.tr

Verbatim research text this claim was extracted from:

> Non-EU. Claims 'Camunda Gold Partner' on its own site but does NOT appear in Camunda's 204-partner directory — unverified · SOURCE: Flowable Partner Finder (flowable.com/company/partners), mined 2026-08-18. NOT imprint-swept.
description: A self-asserted tier the vendor's own registry fails to corroborate; the Istanbul firm is outside the EU scope anyway, but the check itself is the transferable finding.
